snippet.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Beginners Guide Overview
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Beginners Guide Overview for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, an upcoming Marvel fighting game developed by ARC System Works. Players can get the rundown on the basic mechanics, match cadence, and more for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls. The Beginners Guide Overview goes over basic moves, Link Attacks, the Assemble Rush system, and more to keep the pressure on in competitive matches. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC, with the game being playable at EVO 2025.

#IGN #Marvel
